items.title: 迪拜南城与Phoenix Aviation签约建设大型航空维修设施
items.title_en: Dubai South and Phoenix Aviation agree on major aircraft maintenance facility
items.summary: Dubai South与Phoenix Aviation签署在Mohammed bin Rashid Aerospace Hub建设航空维修设施的协议，计划包括35000平方米机库、18000平方米交付中心、15000平方米车间仓储及3000平方米办公设施，目标2029年第一季度完工。
items.summary_en: Dubai South and Phoenix Aviation signed an agreement for an aircraft maintenance facility at Mohammed bin Rashid Aerospace Hub, comprising a 35,000-square-metre hangar, an 18,000-square-metre delivery centre, 15,000 square metres of workshops and stores, and 3,000 square metres of offices, targeting Q1 2029 completion.
items.why_it_matters: 属明确规模的航空产业新开发项目，但尚未公布总承包采购。
items.why_it_matters_en: A substantial new aerospace development with defined scale, but no main construction tender is identified.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注厂房建设、机电、仓储及专业航空设施供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor industrial building, MEP, warehousing and specialist aerospace facility opportunities.

items.title: 迪拜Sobha Realty规划5亿迪拉姆综合物业项目
items.title_en: Dubai Sobha Realty plans AED500 million mixed-use endowment project
items.summary: 迪拜公布Sobha Realty参与规划的Arab Reading Challenge Endowment综合物业项目，位于Al Barsha South 3，规划投资约5亿迪拉姆，预计2027年第一季度开工，包括住宅、办公及商业空间。
items.summary_en: Dubai unveiled plans for the approximately AED500 million Arab Reading Challenge Endowment mixed-use development with Sobha Realty in Al Barsha South 3, with construction expected to begin in Q1 2027 and residential, office and commercial components.
items.why_it_matters: 属于未来建筑及设施采购线索，预计投资不等于已授合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: A prospective construction and facilities supply lead; planned investment is not an awarded contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进项目设计、总包招标与机电建材配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track design, main contracting, MEP and construction material opportunities.

items.title: 拉斯海马启动自动驾驶测试区与智慧交通合作
items.title_en: Ras Al Khaimah launches autonomous mobility testing initiative
items.summary: 拉斯海马宣布自动驾驶测试区及智慧交通技术合作安排，与相关政府及商业伙伴签署10项合作协议。现阶段为测试与合作框架，并非交通基础设施施工合同。
items.summary_en: Ras Al Khaimah announced an autonomous mobility testing initiative and smart-transport cooperation supported by ten agreements with public and private partners. It remains a testing and collaboration initiative rather than an awarded civil works contract.
items.why_it_matters: 项目可带动智慧交通试验及技术服务需求，但尚无可确认的工程金额。
items.why_it_matters_en: The initiative may create intelligent-mobility pilot and technology-service demand, but no construction budget is confirmed.
items.gci_opportunity: 观察自动驾驶测试、数据系统和配套基础设施合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor testing services, data systems and supporting mobility infrastructure.

items.title: 埃及Dandara光伏储能项目获得最高9000万美元融资支持
items.title_en: Egypt Dandara solar and battery project receives up to USD90 million EIB financing support
items.summary: 欧洲投资银行宣布拟提供最高9000万美元融资，支持Scatec开发的Dandara一期569MWp光伏及100MWh储能项目，为EgyptAlum供电。该金额为融资额度，不是工程总造价。
items.summary_en: The European Investment Bank announced financing of up to USD90 million for phase one of Scatec's Dandara project in Egypt, comprising 569 MWp solar generation and 100 MWh battery storage to supply EgyptAlum. The amount is a financing commitment rather than total project cost.
items.why_it_matters: 融资进展提升项目推进确定性，但不代表工程招标开放。
items.why_it_matters_en: Financing progress supports project delivery but does not establish an open construction tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注光伏设备、储能系统、施工及本地供应链合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor solar equipment, storage systems, construction and local supply-chain opportunities.

items.title: 赞比亚至安哥拉830公里Lobito铁路确定优选EPC承包商
items.title_en: Zambia–Angola Lobito railway identifies preferred EPC contractors for 830 km rail corridor
items.summary: Africa Finance Corporation宣布Lobito铁路连通项目全长约830公里，已选定赞比亚段和安哥拉段优选EPC联合体，下一步开展合同谈判；目前不是正式签署的EPC合同。
items.summary_en: Africa Finance Corporation announced preferred EPC contractor consortia for the approximately 830 km Zambia–Angola Lobito rail connection, with contract negotiations to follow. Final EPC contracts have not yet been executed.
items.why_it_matters: 优选承包商阶段可提前布局分包及设备供应渠道。
items.why_it_matters_en: The preferred-contractor stage offers an early window for subcontractor and equipment supply engagement.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注轨道、桥梁、土建、机电及施工设备供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track trackwork, bridges, civil works, systems and construction equipment procurement.

items.title: 阿曼Ibn Firnas与Ambrey签署海事无人机技术合作备忘录
items.title_en: Oman's Ibn Firnas Drone Center and Ambrey partner on maritime drone solutions
items.summary: 阿曼Ibn Firnas Drone Center与国际海事风险管理企业Ambrey签署谅解备忘录，合作开发无人机海事巡逻、沿岸监测及风险管理方案，包括试验、演示和可能的商业化项目。尚无具体采购授标。
items.summary_en: Oman's Ibn Firnas Drone Center signed an MoU with maritime risk-management specialist Ambrey to explore drone solutions for maritime surveillance, coastal monitoring and operational risk management, including demonstrations and potential commercial projects. No procurement award is reported.
items.why_it_matters: 属于技术开发和未来采购线索，商业合同仍需等待。
items.why_it_matters_en: A technology-development lead with potential future procurement, rather than an existing awarded contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进无人机设备、传感器及港口数字化技术合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor UAV hardware, sensors and port digitalisation collaboration.

items.title: 阿曼OMRAN旅游开发集团发布三年通信和ICT服务框架招标
items.title_en: Oman's OMRAN Group tenders three-year telecommunications and ICT framework
items.summary: OMRAN Group发布编号34-2026的三年期通信与ICT框架服务采购，涵盖网络连接、企业Wi-Fi、CCTV、IP语音等。官方明确投标截止2026年11月16日，适用供应商资格要求。
items.summary_en: OMRAN Group issued tender 34-2026 for a three-year telecommunications and ICT call-off framework, covering connectivity, enterprise Wi-Fi, CCTV and IP telephony. Its official tender notice sets 16 November 2026 as the submission deadline, subject to supplier eligibility rules.
items.why_it_matters: 这是具有明确采购截止日的实际公开招标，并非工程建设合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a live procurement with a stated deadline, not a construction award.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注阿曼当地ICT合作伙伴及设备服务分包机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor eligible Omani ICT partners and equipment and service subcontracting.
